name: code-distilling
description: Port high-quality implementations from reference open-source repos into your project through a design-aware spec and direct implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Disciplined porting of features from reference open-source repos into your project.
interface.longDescription: Analyze a reference feature's architecture, workflow, domain rules, prompts, and behavioral invariants. Capture those decisions and target integration in a distillation spec, then implement directly and verify fidelity without a separate plan stage or mandatory subagents. Later, catch the port up with reference changes and close remaining gaps through the same review gate.
defaultPrompt: I want to port a feature from /path/to/reference-repo into my project.
Help me distill the OAuth implementation from this reference.
Catch my port of this feature up with the latest changes in its reference repo.
